prompt: Add a Badge component to the library. It should support a few color variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline) and render as a small pill-shaped label. We use it to tag statuses on cards.
assertions: Uses cva for variants in a *-variants.ts file
Does NOT pull in a Radix behavioral primitive (only Slot allowed)
Uses standard semantic utilities (bg-primary / bg-secondary / bg-destructive / border-input)
No hardcoded hex/px or bare arbitrary color literals
DarkMode story sets BOTH data-theme=dark and .dark
